customManagers.description: Dockerfile: BASE_IMAGE ARG default. Must track DISTROLESS_* in versions.env, or a direct `docker build` silently uses a stale digest-pinned base while `task image` uses the fresh one.
versions.env: single-value tool and binary pins (including SYFT_CLI_VERSION -- do not add a second manager for it, both would extract the same dep)

packageRules.description: A syft pin bump is a runtime behavior change; release it as a patch (fix). Matches the github-releases datasource the versions.env custom manager emits -- the pin is a release tarball.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ `SYFT_CLI_SHA256_LINUX_*` in `versions.env` are **not** updated by this PR. Run `task syft:checksums` and commit the result, or every `task build:syft` will fail checksum verification.

packageRules.description: Base image / tooling / CI action bumps are chores.
